labels_are_integers.detail: HDBSCAN.labels_ must be integer-typed for all points

core_distances_computed.detail: outlier_scores_ (GLOSH) must be non-None, length==n_samples, all >= 0 (replaces core_distances_ in newer hdbscan)

not_all_noise.detail: on two well-separated blobs at least some points must be cluster-assigned

single_point_all_noise.detail: raised exception (also acceptable for single point): k must be less than or equal to the number of training points

min_cluster_size_2.detail: min_cluster_size=2 on 20-point two-blob data should yield >= 1 cluster

min_cluster_size_20.detail: min_cluster_size=20 on 20 total points yields <= 1 cluster

min_cluster_size_changes_result.detail: min_cluster_size=2 vs min_cluster_size=20 must differ in cluster count
